title: Join IG Markets via App, Invest Min. $100 in Share or ETF, Hold for 30 Days & Get up to $200 Cash @ IG Group
body:
Deal: Join IG Markets via App, Invest Min. $100 in Share or ETF, Hold for 30 Days & Get up to $200 Cash @ IG Group

[scootsie] Looks like new customers only from the T&C's
This Promotion is available exclusively to Qualifying Participants. In order to be a “Qualifying Participant” you must meet
all of the following criteria:
a. Successfully open an IG Account during the Promotional Period;
b. Be an Australian resident;
c. You must not hold or have previously held an IG Account
[Avi0001] Can anyone confirm that can we combine with the crypto deal as well or not?
[CS Analyst] Promotion is limited to the first 1,000 eligible customers
[GreenLego] I was going to comment this as well.
How do we know that the 1,000 cash rewards hasn't already been claimed?
[CS Analyst] From Claude: You can't know for certain from the outside.
[prisonmike] How’s IG Market compared to other direct investor platforms ?
[sinners007] I joined on a previous $100 sign up offer. I had to chase them for a month to get the money.
Additionally, you never legally hold/own the shares. IG holds them on your behalf & you are the "beneficial" owner.
As for the platform, it's ok. UI is subjectively fine. Fee free trading is worthwhile if you like flipping shares often & don't want to pay the Commsec type brokerage fees.
Unlike Commsec, you can't put a buy order in unless you have the money in your IG account to pay for that order if it comes through.
Adding & withdrawing money is pretty instant.
I use Commsec for big investments that I plan to hold for a long time & IG for some fun & day trading.
[MingMerciless] Important terms
Promotion period: 18 May 2026 (12:01am) – 31 July 2026 (11:59pm) AET, or when 1,000 cash rewards have been issued, whichever occurs first
Limited offer: First 1,000 eligible customers only
Eligibility: New IG clients who have received a marketing communication regarding this promotion
Qualifying trade: Minimum $90 share purchase (buy transaction only) executed through the IG Share Trading platform
Hold period: You must hold the full position of your qualifying trade for a minimum of 30 days from the date of purchase
Credit payment: Cash is deposited into your share trading account within 7 business days of the hold period ending
One per customer: Only one account per customer is eligible
Available to new clients, limited spots only, T&Cs apply. IG Australia Pty Ltd, AFSL 515106.
Promotion has run for two months. How likely to still be eligible?
Also eligibility criteria requires receiving a "marketing communication"?
